verdicts.reason: A: all the text has been pulled out of the label frame into a scattered left column ('LAVANDER' is weak, 'SKINCARE' is tiny, 'HOMEMADE LOTION' is shoved into the bottom-left corner). That leaves the frame as a large empty box with orphaned divider rules. The illustration row does survive at a readable scale along the bottom. B: the frame is empty and its divider rules spill past its right edge; one stray rule cuts through the shrunken illustrations. The text is strung across the top in a single row with no hierarchy, and the product art is reduced to an illegible thumbnail strip, so the original design is lost.
